title: Retry: add code-health check, status table, 10-landing design review
summary: Retry of 20261026-064950-38jx for Sri and the verifier. Redo the code-health work: code_health.rs measures, an athena status table with thresholds, one structural-pass request per breaching file after each landing, and a self-contained design-review request every 10 landings. The earlier code was rejected only because the sandbox's 10 GB low-disk guard failed one unrelated integration test, so the code itself is not at fault.

defaults_applied.how: All new code is Rust in the athena-core and athena-cli crates.
Criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass.
Criteria check measures, queueing and rendered output by running tests.
The status table and hooks are exercised through tests.
decisions.md records the call on measuring function length (a parser crate versus a line scan).
Scope recovered from the earlier job's accepted reading and corrections.
One focused change; the disk-hold fix is left out.
The design-review request text is self-contained.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The typed request (retry the original job) takes precedence over the introspection's proposed disk-hold fix; that fix is a separate request.
The retry starts from base, since the test check failed, not from the old candidate.
The low-disk failure in binary.rs is environmental; the producer must not edit or weaken that guard, and the evidence must cite cargo test output that was seen to run.
Review cadence is derived from landing records where possible, so a lost state directory does not shift it; the earlier state-file baseline is avoided or kept minimal.
Hook tests live in a code_health::hooks module inside the core crate, not a new integration test file.
The design-review request text carries its whole content, because no design-review role exists.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a code_health test with fixture source files and landing records asserts per-file production line count (excluding #[cfg(test)] modules), longest function length, landings in the last 7 days, and failure/rejection citations.

Run cargo test: tests show a breach of each threshold (file over 2000 lines, function over 200 lines, over 1500 lines with 5 or more landings in a week) is reported, and a file under the thresholds is not flagged.

Run cargo test: on a breach exactly one structural-pass request is queued for that file, citing the measured numbers; running again, or with an open structural-pass request for that file, queues none.

Run cargo test: the design-review request is queued at high priority at the 10th landed job since the last review and not at the 9th; with no earlier review request, the first review does not fire at once on existing history.

Run cargo test: the queued design-review text names what to review (code-health table, files most changed and most broken since the last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops) and what to produce (a short design note with proposed changes, as a design-only job).
Run cargo test: a test of the Athena::land_pr path shows the code-health check is invoked after a landing, and fails without the hook.

Run cargo test: the rendered athena status output contains the code-health table with each file's lines, longest function, weekly landings, citations, thresholds, whether over, and test suite run time, with header columns aligned to their labels.
Run cargo clippy with -D warnings, cargo fmt --check and cargo test: all pass on the tree, and the evidence cites these commands as run.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and docs/decisions.md records the thresholds, the buy-versus-build call on measuring function length, and the 10-landing cadence.

out_of_scope: Changing Athena's pre-check disk measurement, build-directory cleanup, or mapping the low-disk guard to an environment hold (a separate request).
Editing or weakening the low-disk guard in the binary.rs integration test.
Building a real design-review role or agent beyond the queued request text.
departures: The change is larger than a typical job, and the sandbox low-disk guard could fail cargo test again, so cost, time and pass probability are adjusted from the reference.
urgent_reason: Retrying this job removes a rejected attempt caused by environment; the original asked for priority urgent, but this reading adds no new time savings, so it is not marked urgent.
